sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative food image for a Russian home cooking recipe catalog. Create a photorealistic editorial food photograph, landscape 3:2 composition. One ordinary home-prepared dish in a light ceramic bowl or on a white plate, fully visible with comfortable margins, viewed from a 45-degree overhead angle, filling most of the frame. Light neutral linen or stone table, soft natural daylight, realistic textures and true ingredient colors, inviting but not glossy advertising. Simple serving, no unrelated side dishes or ingredients. No people, hands, utensils, packaging, text, watermark or logos. Keep all important food inside the central 80 percent for responsive cropping. Depict only the exact prepared ingredients in the subject description, no extra garnishes.
